"With this...will I grow stronger?"
Old prayer beads of unknown origin passed down since long ago. It is said that depending on the nature of the wearer, it can grant partial control of natural power.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases damage by 8% → 16% when the caster attacks with a Single Attack and increases damage by an additional 8% → 16% if the enemy is granted a barrier.
artifacts.lore_en: An enormous crown that Chloe carries with her for the moment when she becomes a true queen. She aspires to become a queen whose power is as impressive and glamorous as the crown itself. As for where and how she found it... That's Chloe's secret!

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Dual Attack chance by 7% → 14%. When it is not the caster's turn, increases Effectiveness by 2% → 4%.
artifacts.lore_en: It's hard to even venture a guess as to when this red marble was created. This marble creates the illusion that an immense full moon has risen in the sky, bringing forth the deep madness hidden within any who see it and trapping them in a never-ending hallucination.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the turn, for each buff granted to an enemy, has a 6% → 12% chance to grant increased Attack (Greater) for 1 turn. At the end of the turn, has a 5% → 10% chance to grant stealth for 1 turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A device that can restrict access to certain districts under the authority of the police. Unless granted access from the authorities, no one can enter.

artifacts.effect_en: When using an attack that targets all enemies, increases damage dealt by 7% → 14%, with a 1% → 2% chance to decrease skill cooldown by 1 turn.
artifacts.lore_en:
"You finally found what you wanted, my lady."
"Stop imposing on me, you fool."
Oblivious to the events that would soon unfold before them, Baal smiled to himself when Sezan found the spell for the forbidden magic ceremony.

artifacts.effect_en: Increase Evasion by 20%. Damage dealt increases by 6% → 12% when attacking, and as Health decreases, damage dealt increases, up to a maximum of 1.2% → 2.4%
artifacts.lore_en:
"To those fools who cannot be redeemed: kneel down, despair, and obey."
Those who fell to his sword soon lost themselves and rose up as Dust Walkers.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases the EXP acquired by Heroes in the team by 15%. When more than one Artifact that increases EXP is equipped, only the strongest effect is applied, and this effect will not be applied when used via a Supporter. The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: Ras and the Heirs have been invited to a banquet in celebration of Ezeran Foundation Day. As they leave the hardships they suffered behind them, they raise their glasses in anticipation of a new, peaceful world.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Defense and Effect Resistance of all allies by 2.5% → 5%. Effect does not stack with other Artifacts of the same name.
artifacts.lore_en: Magical ore that the Emporium specially refines and distributes every year for the Moonlight Reception. People pray for peace in the next year as they gaze at the moonlight stored inside the ore.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking with a Single Attack, has a 7.5% → 15% chance to detonate any bleeding and burn effects inflicted on the target at the end of the turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A boy with a scythe crossed the threshold of life and death a number of times, and with each crisis he faced, he was reborn with a stronger desire to live. His red scythe symbolizes endings transforming into new beginnings and old blood transforming into new strength.

artifacts.effect_en: Deals 50 → 100 fixed damage to the target after attacking.
artifacts.lore_en: After suffering the pain of deceit and betrayal, the pillars of her heart collapsed, and as she escaped the prison of passion, she embraced the freedom of destruction. However, her greed is building a new tower that will imprison her once more.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking with a Single Attack, has a 7.5% → 15% chance to steal one buff from the target.
artifacts.lore_en: A girl with a large marble creates nightmares as she dances in the moonlight. These malicious illusions that blur the lines of purity and evil are actually a desperate attempt to bury the scars hidden deep within her subconscious. The whole world may know, but you might not.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Evasion by 20%. After successfully evading, has a 2.5% → 5% chance to counterattack.
artifacts.lore_en: "Were the trusty sword on your shoulder to slip even slightly, it could slit your throat. The same is true of people—the closer you keep them, the more easily they're able to harm you."

artifacts.effect_en: When using a skill that targets all enemies, penetrates the target's Defense by 1% → 2%. When defeating an enemy with a skill that targets all enemies, increases Combat Readiness of all allies except for the caster by 10%.
artifacts.lore_en: A sword given to Vildred by the eastern swordsman who taught him swordsmanship. It glows faintly when moonlight strikes its surface. It is known as the Summer Sword, one of the four swords crafted long, long ago.

artifacts.effect_en: After the caster uses a non-attack skill, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 1% → 2% and acquires 10 Souls. Souls can only be acquired once.
artifacts.lore_en: A mobile data device created just for Flan. It supports hologram displays and allows Flan to access Politia's information network anytime, anywhere.

artifacts.effect_en:
Increases the Friendship acquired after completing a stage in Adventure, Side Story, Spirit Altar, Emergency Mission, Hunt, Rift, and Otherworld Breach by the Hero who has this Artifact equipped by 100%.
The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: In this infinite universe, this neverending chain of connections, we were destined to be together! No matter what stands in our way, we will be the ray of hope protecting this world! Right?

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking, increases Hit Chance by 1% → 2% and damage dealt by 8% → 16%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: "The valor of one is not enough to earn victory for all—you must make colleagues you can trust and rely on. It is only once you are connected by your determination and have become one another's swords and shields that victory will be yours."

artifacts.effect_en: After the caster uses a non-attack skill, decreases skill cooldowns of all allies by 1 turn, and has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Critical Hit Damage of the caster for 2 turns. Skill cooldown reduction effect can only be activated once.
artifacts.lore_en: A magical tool that can be used to move to a golden chamber filled with rare goods and weaponry that lie sleeping. Once unlocked, the tool allows one to access the passage to the treasure chamber from anywhere.

artifacts.effect_en: After an extra attack, counterattack, or Dual Attack, has a 4% → 8% chance to dispel one buff from the target, and a 100% chance to deal 1,000 → 2,000 fixed damage.
artifacts.lore_en: A girl with a bouncy blue skirt dashes from place to place, just like a rabbit. Where could she be going? Perhaps the answer lies within a fairy tale.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Hit Chance by 1% → 2% and Critical Hit Damage by 1.5% → 3%.
artifacts.lore_en: Kanna's favorite missile. She holds it in her arms every night before she switches off to sleep mode, dreaming of the day she can finally use it.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 1.5% → 3%. Has a 5% → 10% chance to grant increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns after an ally uses a non-attack skill. Can only be activated once every 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: It is said that all those who looked into the brilliant twilight emitted by the staff drowned in a pool of light redder than blood.

artifacts.effect_en: Upon receiving lethal damage, has a 5% → 10% chance to grant all allies except for the caster a random buff for 2 turns (Increase Attack (Greater), Increase Defense, Increase Evasion, Immunity, or Increase Critical Hit Resistance). Can only be activated once per battle.
artifacts.lore_en: A capsule created in preparation for the final days of Politis's home planet, Paradia. It's a cache of Paradia's heritage that includes relics of their technology, knowledge, culture, and art so that their legacy can live on even if their planet disappears.

artifacts.effect_en: After the caster uses a basic skill, recovers Health of the ally except for the caster with the highest Attack by 4% → 8%.
artifacts.lore_en: The most highly valued relic in a city that worships stars. This relic is considered to be blessed by the Guardian Star, and every year, the high priestess uses it during a special event to offer a prayer of gratitude to the Guardian Star.

artifacts.effect_en: After using a basic skill, grants a barrier equivalent to 5% → 10% of the caster's max Health for 2 turns to the ally except for the caster with the lowest Health. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: With a stack of papers clutched to her chest, the girl buries the truth in a pile of valuable records that no one pays attention to. She silently endures as she limits her own potential.

artifacts.effect_en: Increaes Attack of all allies by 5% → 10%. At the end of every 3 enemy turns, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 1% → 2%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: "The battlefield is full of frightened and terrified souls, but only defeat awaits those who fail to overcome their fears. Now, with the sound of this horn, transform those fears into courage."

artifacts.effect_en: After using a basic skill, has a 50% → 100% chance to inflict additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack on the target.
artifacts.lore_en: This spear is said to have been used by a knight who reclaimed the throne and established a new kingdom. Legends say that whoever takes hold of this spear can begin a new era, and as a result, many covet the spear, but its whereabouts are currently unknown. However, there have been reports recently that a knight with silver hair wields a similar-looking spear.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 15%. When somebody dies, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 1.2% → 2.4%. Can be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: It's a very heavy iron ball on a chain, but Rem wields it as though it were light as a feather.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 15%. When attacked by an Elite or Boss monster, damage suffered is decreased by 1% → 2%. When more than one damage reduction effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: This is the wand Ram carries with her. She wields it often when using magic.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 15%. When attacking, increases damage dealt by 7% → 14%, and a critical hit increases the damage of the next attack by an additional 4% → 8%.
artifacts.lore_en: A spear forged with rage and sorrow and tempered with resentment. Under a flash of white light, everything collapsed; under a looming dark shadow, nothing could escape.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance by 15%. When an ally's Health is 50% or less after being attacked, recovers Health of the target by 1% → 2%. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: Emilia forms ice crystals to protect those she holds dear.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance of all allies by 5%. After attacking with a Single Attack, deals 100 → 200 fixed damage to a random enemy except for the target. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: It may look like a regular beach volleyball, but after Cermia and Alexa used this volleyball in a match, its value has increased. Because it's highly unlikely that these two will continue to play volleyball, the value of this ball keeps increasing.

artifacts.effect_en: Decreases damage suffered from a critical hit by 30%. When more than one damage reduction effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied. If an ally is attacked when it's not the caster's turn, has a 15% chance to activate Dimensional Rupture. Dimensional Rupture can only be activated once every 2 turns. The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: A device modified from a mysterious magic accessory that was given to Ras. By adding magic equations and auxiliary equipment to the device, Mercedes can now safely wield her incredible power.

artifacts.effect_en: When the caster suffers a non-critical hit, has a 1.5% → 3% chance to counterattack.
artifacts.lore_en: Upgraded Dragon Knuckles are a gift from Rimuru that Milim really likes. They have an effect that reduces Milim's strength, allowing her to control her power.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the turn, has a 5% → 10% chance to grant a random buff to the caster for 2 turns. (Immunity, Increase Attack, Increase Defense, Increase Critical Hit Damage, Increase Speed)
artifacts.lore_en: A mask Rimuru received from Shizu. Shizu asked Rimuru to absorb her, and Rimuru inherited Shizu's appearance, mask, and memories.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance by 1% → 2%. Increases Effectiveness by 15% at the end of the caster's turn. This effect can only stack up to 3 times and resets at the start of battle.
artifacts.lore_en: Shuna made these clothes based on the clothing worn in Ritania using her skill, Analytic (Comprehender). It's perfection, both functionally and aesthetically.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 1.5% → 3%. Has a 5% → 10% chance to plant a bomb on the target for 2 turns after using a basic skill. This effect is applied to Single Attacks and is not activated by a counterattack, Dual Attack, or extra attack.
artifacts.lore_en: A gem of profound and mysterious sheen, sometimes found in seashells. It is said that these are pieces of a star that fell off as it was shaking water off its body after freshening up at sea.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases the EXP acquired by Heroes in the team by 15%. When more than one Artifact that increases EXP is equipped, only the strongest effect is applied, and this effect will not be applied when used via a Supporter. The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: The citylords gathered in Aakhen to celebrate Cidonia's peace and harmony, with the hope that no one else will have to suffer from the hardships of war ever again.

artifacts.fr: Trophée de la pleine lune enflammée
artifacts.effect_en: When an enemy is defeated, recovers Health of all allies by 7% → 14%. Can only be activated once per turn. Effect does not stack with other Artifacts of the same name.
artifacts.lore_en: A trophy provided by the Meldrec to celebrate the Full Moon Harvest Festival. Given to the winner of the contest who has eliminated the most monsters.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 15%. After using a non-attack skill, has a 5% → 10% chance each to gain 10 Soul and remove 15 Soul from the enemy. Soul can only be acquired once.
artifacts.lore_en: One of the Four Seasons Swords that was made in the distant past. Unlike other swords, the Winter Sword's innate power flows on its surface without restraint. It is said that those who are not chosen by the sword will find themselves frozen by Its power if they try to wield it.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance of all allies by 1% → 2%, and the caster's Effect Resistance by an additional 2.5% → 5%. The caster's Effect Resistance decreases by 3% with each attack suffered, down to 1% → 3.5%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: "When it becomes apparent that you're on the verge of defeat, soldiers will often become frustrated and surrender. When that time comes, take hold of this shield and save your soldiers. This shield will be a symbol that reinvigorates your troops, encouraging those who are in despair to continue to move forward toward victory."

artifacts.effect_en: After using a non-attack skill, gains 10 Soul and has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Critical Hit Damage of the caster for 2 turns. Soul can only be acquired once.
artifacts.lore_en: A sword and costume that the Shadow Elves had presented to Humans in the distant past as a token of their trust while interacting with them. They contain the Spirits' blessing as well as the Shadow Elves' magic. Having been passed from owner to owner, it has now fallen into Zahhak's possession after the collapse of the Human kingdom.

artifacts.effect_en:
Increases the Friendship acquired after completing a stage in Adventure, Side Story, Spirit Altar, Emergency Mission, Hunt, Rift, and Otherworld Breach by the Hero who has this Artifact equipped by 100%.
The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: I believe that no matter the hardships you may face, or how far apart we may be, your light will never fade. No matter what happens, you'll be able to get through it!

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Defense by 5% → 10%. At the end of the turn, grants a random buff to one random ally for 1 turn. (Barrier, Increase Defense, Immunity, or Continuous Healing) Barrier streangth increases proportional to the target's max Health.
artifacts.lore_en: A hologram music box emitting mysterious light. It reminds you of old memories since it shows whatever you desire, but it often ends up leaving you with a longing heart.

artifacts.effect_en: After using a non-attack skill, grants a barrier equivalent to 30 → 60 per Level to all allies for 2 turns. This effect can only be activated once every 3 turns. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: It is named after its shape which looks like wings floating around the bearer. However, instead of being used for flight, it is used to project energy to attack, or to create a barrier to defend.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 1.5% → 3%. After using a non-attack skill, decreases skill cooldown by 1 turn. Can only be activated three times per battle.
artifacts.lore_en: An object handed down in Peira's exterminated tribe. It contains the power of the previous chiefs, and is said to grant those who are able to complete the ceremony their power and spirit. However, with most individuals losing their sanity before completing the ceremony, there have been very few to actually take on the challenge.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness of all allies by 10%. If the target has a debuff when the caster attacks with a Single Attack, increases damage by 1.2% → 2.4%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: A mask that controls her emotional changes and an iron ball that she uses when fighting. Both are always carried by Jack-O' and resemble jack-o'-lanterns.

artifacts.effect_en: If the caster attacks when it's not their turn, damage dealt increases by 8% → 16%, and after attacking, has a 50% chance to inflict a random debuff on the target for 1 turn (Decrease Defense, Decrease Speed, Silence, or Unable to be buffed).
artifacts.lore_en: A scroll to summon contracted creatures through shadow magic. The scroll became full of words as she learned more magic.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 6% → 12%. At the start of the first battle, when anyone on the team is granted the effect of IV. The Emperor, also increases Defense by 6% → 12%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: She wears a crown made of twinkling stars and has eyes that shine with intelligence. For her, there will always be only one truth and answer, even if he does not exist by her side.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Defense by 6% → 12%. At the start of the first battle, when anyone on the team is granted the effect of III. The Empress, also increases Attack by 6% → 12%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: He wears the sun's radiance atop his head and receives the admiration of his people. For him, the sole reason for his dedication and the only weakness in his life will always be there with him, even if she does not exist by his side.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 10%. If a non-critical hit is made when attacking, has a 5% → 10% chance to burn for 1 turn. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: Gaiters worn by Hwayoung ever since she became a martial artist. It is an object that is said to have been crafted by combining the techniques of several ancient races. Despite being used for a long time, it is so tough that it remains without a scratch.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 1% → 2%. After an enemy uses a non-attack skill, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 10%. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A spear made with the body and energy of a Great Wicked that was defeated after countless sacrifices were made during a great war in the distant past. It is known to unleash one's physical limit to their extremities, but most wielders faced tragic ends when they could not handle the potential of the spear.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 10%. After an extra attack, increases Critical Hit Damage by 4% → 8%, and Speed by 4% → 8%. Can stack up to 4 times.
artifacts.lore_en: The artificial arm and leg that Winry created for Edward. Though it sometimes gets destroyed during battles, it becomes more durable every time it gets fixed. Winry takes great pride in it.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Hit Chance by 1% → 2% and Attack by 7% → 14%.
artifacts.lore_en: Gloves that have transmutation circles drawn into the fabric. They are made from a special flammable fabric. Combined with Roy's proficiency in oxygen manipulation alchemy, the gloves allow him to ignite huge flames.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 25%. A critical hit has a 3.5% → 7% chance to increase Speed of the caster for 1 turn.
artifacts.lore_en: Riza's favorite handgun. Though she owns many different types, she uses this one the most. She carries it with her everywhere, whether it be for missions or even going about her daily routine.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of battle, grants a barrier (proportional to max Health) to the caster for 2 turns. When attacking with a Single Attack, increases damage dealt by 8% → 16%.
artifacts.lore_en: A metallic sphere that is connected to Yulha's consciousness. It can freely change form and density at her discretion. While it is most often used as a form of defense, it can also be used as a form of offense. Due to its resiliency, the sphere can quickly regenerate after being destroyed.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Damage by 1.5% → 3%. When attacked, grants 1% → 2% damage reduction.
artifacts.lore_en: A pair of sunglasses Charlotte bought in an attempt to look mature. No one has to know that she has put them on and taken them off in front of a mirror dozens of times.

artifacts.effect_en: At the end of the turn, recovers 400 → 800 Health, shared between the casters and the ally except for the caster with the lowest Health.
artifacts.lore_en: What left a stronger impression than that summer's scorching sun was the trivial memory of sharing ice cream together.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Defense by 2.5% → 5%. After attacking on the caster's turn, when the caster is bleeding, dispels one debuff from the caster.
artifacts.lore_en: No fierce wind or wave can stop her. Breaking through all hardships and obstacles, that’s what youth is all about!

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 1.5% → 3%. After attacking, increases Combat Readiness of the caster and ally except for the caster with the highest Attack by 10%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: A sacred object pilgrims use when performing a ceremony. It's made from a portion of a giant sacred tree that existed in the past. It is said that this object amplifies the bearer's foresight ability and allows them to take a peek at the future's various possibilities.

artifacts.effect_en: Celebrates the new era with a cannon salute. Increases damage dealt by 20% if the target's Health is 50% or more when the caster attacks. This Artifact's effect remains the same regardless of its level.
artifacts.lore_en: Leaving behind the chaotic past and with peace in their time, those who have survived have joined forces together. With their own individual goals in mind, they strive to create an ideal world.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 20%. After using a non-attack skill, has a 5% → 10% chance to grant stealth to the ally with the highest Attack except for the caster for 2 turns. Can only be activated once every 3 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: A fan that creates a rift between spaces. It allows the bearer to open and close Dimensional Gates wherever they like. Within the gate is an imaginary space conjured with Lua's power, and therefore no one can escape without her permission.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack of all allies by 5% → 10% , and increases Hit Chance of the caster by 1% → 2%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: The Autumn Sword has been passed down through the Suin of the Prairie for a long time. It is said that the sword can only be lifted by those that the sword has acknowledged. The sword imbues its bearer and those around them with unwavering courage and hope.

artifacts.effect_en: When a non-critical hit is made after using a basic skill, has a 5% → 10% chance to burn the target for 2 turns. Only applies to Single Attacks.
artifacts.lore_en: A mysterious scroll used by a monk that fought against the demons of Natalon. Demons that caused tremendous chaos have been sealed within as drawings.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Evasion by 20%. When attacking, if the caster is at an elemental advantage, increases damage dealt by 25%. The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: The sword that contains the harmonized power of the Spirit Lords that reside within each of the Four Seasons Swords. The only person that can wield this blade to its truest potential is Actin, Silvana's successor and Savior of Natalon.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking with a Single Attack, has a 5% → 10% chance to inflict additional damage proportional to the caster's Defense on the target.
artifacts.lore_en: ae-KARINA's main weapon. Just like its name, Rocket Punch is a powerful gauntlet that can destroy enemies in a single strike.

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking with a Single Attack, increases damage dealt by 8% → 16%. When the enemy is defeated by a Single Attack, gains 10 Souls at the start of the next turn. The effect upon defeating an enemy can only be activated once.
artifacts.lore_en: ae-GISELLE's special frame that glows translucently. It can completely immobilize anyone who is touched by its frame.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 15%. After using a non-attack skill, grants a barrier equal to 30 → 60 per Level for 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: ae-WINTER‘s main weapon. The Armament, like its name, can transform into any type of weapon, allowing its owner to fight at her best even in the worst scenarios.

artifacts.effect_en: After using a non-attack skill, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 1% → 2%, and removes 10 → 20 Soul from the enemy. Soul removal can only be activated once every 4 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: One of ae-NINGNING's multiple hacking tools that allows her to track all sorts of metadata. It is also known as Ed, which shares the same name as the hacker group she's affiliated with.

artifacts.effect_en: At the end of the turn, Increases Attack by 1% → 2%, Critical Hit Chance by 1% → 2%, and Critical Hit Damage by 1% → 2%. Can stack up to 10 times.
artifacts.lore_en: A passage connected to the REAL WORLD, FLAT, and KWANGYA. Only nævis—the Gate Manager—can open it.

artifacts.effect_en: After using a non-attack skill, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 1% → 2%, and after the next attack burns the target for 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: A blue flame that is connected with Beehoo's consciousness. It can freely change into a variety of shapes at his discretion and can easily pick out a target from within a crowd. However, it can't be used for a prolonged period for it burns his life force.

artifacts.effect_en: After using a non-attack skill twice, increases Combat Readiness of the ally with the highest Attack by 1% → 2% and has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Critical Hit Damage for 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: One of the objects that Spirit Lord Noias gifted to the shadow Elves in the past. When the Shadow Elves settled down in Natalon, Silvana also blessed it with their energy.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of battle, grants a barrier equivalent to 20 → 40 per Level of the caster to the caster and the foremost ally for 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: The moment when these two strangers came together and held hands for the first time, they both thought the same thing. Would they be able to hold on no matter the hardships ahead?

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking with a Single Attack, penetrates the target's Defense by 1% → 2%. After attacking with a Single Attack, when the target receives damage equivalent to 50% or more of max Health, has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Combat Readiness of all allies by 15%. Combat Readiness increase effect can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: The first pistol Eligos purchased when he left Taranor's world of crime and founded the Dagger Sicar. He will only pull out this piece when there is an issue that must be resolved.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases the EXP acquired by Heroes in the team by 15%. When more than one Artifact that increases EXP is equipped, only the strongest effect is applied, and this effect will not be applied when used via a Supporter. The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: There’s nobody whose heart wouldn’t be stolen by an adorable baby panda. Except, that is, for a certain blue mascot who might feel their position is under attack…

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the first battle, has a 5% → 10% chance to grant immunity for 1 turn. At the start of the turn, when the caster does not have a debuff, has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Attack for 1 turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A tachi wielded by the Commander-in-Chief, Benimaru. Created by the blacksmith Kurobe, it is a near-perfect weapon that can withstand Benimaru's flames.

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking, if the caster's Health is 50% or more, increases damage dealt by 8% → 16%, and when Health is less than 50%, recovers 1.5% → 3% of damage dealt.
artifacts.lore_en: A rose made of gold in remembrance of the past glory and splendor of the Bloodrose family. It symbolizes unwithering beauty and passion.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance by 2% → 4%. After an enemy uses a non-attack skill, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 8% → 16%. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: "When I'm with you, you make me forget all the hardships." Sometimes the small bit of warmth at one's fingertips can be more comforting than any words.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Health by 5% → 10%. When attacking, increases damage dealt by 5% → 10% and when it is an extra attack, increases damage dealt by an additional 5% → 10%
artifacts.lore_en: She looks up at the night sky, shrouded in the pitch-black robe of the darkness, and sees a lone star, shining brightly. She wishes upon the star with a desperate heart, asking it to stay by her side.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking, has a 3% → 6% chance to decrease Defense of the target for 1 turn. This effect is not activated by a counterattack, Dual Attack, or extra attack.
artifacts.lore_en: After sealing away the demons, she returned to the shrine and lit a candle, hoping to bring eternal peace to the world.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Hit Chance by 1% → 2%. When attacking, penetrates the target's Defense by 8% → 16%.
artifacts.lore_en: A token that once belonged to a high priest. It symbolizes a faithful heart towards Noias. Though the token is broken, his faith will be dutifully handed down to remaining successors.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance by 2% → 4%. When attacking, increases damage dealt by 5% → 10%, and when the target's Health is 50% or more, increases damage dealt by an additional 4% → 8%.
artifacts.lore_en: Following the wave of agony that descended upon the depraved underground, a new hostess emerges to claim her rightful place.

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking, increases damage dealt by 20% against Elite or Boss monsters. The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: Following a season of icy darkness, a season of resplendent light—the light of hope—finally arrives. Warm smiles abound as testament to this joyous moment, achieved only because everyone was there to support each other. "Though our journey may bring changes to our lives just like how the seasons pass, the miracle we created together shall never fade."

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking, increases damage dealt by 8% → 16%, and for each debuff inflicted on the enemy, increases by 4%, up to 2.4% → 3.2%.
artifacts.lore_en: A notorious family treasure of the Drake family, infamous for ending battles in bloodshed and terror. It had been missing for a long time until the most recent successor emerged and started a war.

artifacts.effect_en: Increase Effectiveness by 1% → 2% and Effect Resistance by 2% → 4%. The caster's Effect Resistance decreasess by 2% → 4% with each attack suffered, down to 1% → 2%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: Ainz's personal weapon and the symbol of Ainz Ooal Gown, crafted by his Guild members. Its power is of the same level as that of a World Item, and it's entwined by seven serpents, each adorned with a Divine-class artifact gemstone in the mouth.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 1.5% → 3%. After an extra attack, decreases Combat Readiness of the target by 1.2% → 2.4%. Can only be activated once every 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: "After you've been chewed and digested... We're going to merge into one and be reborn anew." Enticing her prey, her voice sounds sweeter than honey.

artifacts.effect_en: After using an attack that targets all enemies except for a basic skill, has a 60% chance to inflict a random debuff on the target for 1 turn, and has a 5% → 10% chance to grant stealth to the caster for 1 turn. Can only be activated once per turn. (Decrease Attack, Decrease Speed, Unhealable, or Silence)
artifacts.lore_en: "I'm too afraid to use it anymore, it looks like it'll break at any moment. Well, what can you expect from a tacky toy a kid could barely afford with her allowance money," said Byblis, as she carefully put away her shears into a drawer.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance by 15% → 30%. After using an attack except for a basic skill, when a non-critical hit is made, removes 10 → 20 Soul from the enemy. Soul removal can only be activated once every 4 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: "In my presence, there's nothing you can do." In the pitch-black night, nothing remained except the echo of her wings flapping.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking, has a 5% → 10% chance to deal additional damage proportional to the caster's max Health on the target.
artifacts.lore_en: Albedo's main weapon, a giant bardiche. Wielding 3F, she punishes those who have been disrespectful to Ainz without hesitation.

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking with a Single Attack, increases damage dealt by 1% → 2% and absorbs 15% of the damage dealt as Health.
artifacts.lore_en: A Divine-class lance, which serves as Shalltear's main weapon. Resembling a giant spuit covered in metal adornments, it has the powerful ability to recover the wielder's health proportional to the damage dealt.

artifacts.effect_en: Increase Effectiveness by 1% → 2% and Effect Resistance by 2% → 4%. The caster's Effect Resistance decreasess by 2% → 4% with each attack suffered, down to 1% → 2%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: Ainz's personal weapon and the symbol of Ainz Ooal Gown, crafted by his Guild members. Its power is of the same level as that of a World Item, and it's entwined by seven serpents, each adorned with a Divine-class artifact gemstone in the mouth.

artifacts.fr: Souvenir du festival du Nouvel An
artifacts.effect_en:
Increases the Friendship acquired after completing a stage in Adventure, Side Story, Spirit Altar, Emergency Mission, Hunt, Rift, and Otherworld Breach by the Hero who has this Artifact equipped by 100%.
The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: Dolls that can be seen everywhere, and snacks that are easily found. The reason such common items feel precious is probably because they hold special memories.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Health by 5% → 10%. At the start of the turn has a 5% → 10% chance to decrease debuff durations of the caster by 1 turn. Can only be activated once every 3 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: Being able to sing on stage feels like a miracle to me. Would you like to be part of our sweet miracle?

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of battle, recovers Health of all allies by 10%, and has a 5% → 10% chance to decrease skill cooldowns of the caster by 1 turn. Skill cooldown reduction effect can only be activated three times. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: She will continue to dream until her little wish reaches the stars, for the day she gets to perform on a grander stage with her mentor...

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 15%. After using a non-attack skill, grants a barrier equivalent to 3.5% → 7% of Attack for 2 turns. Barrier can only be granted once every 3 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: An ancestral sword of the Lenox family, crafted for those who keep their oaths. As a gift of gratitude and admiration, Conwell gifted it to Jenua Roland, who lost one of his legs while guarding Conwell.

artifacts.effect_en: After using a non-attack skill, acquires 10 → 20 Soul. Can only be activated once.
artifacts.lore_en: A family heirloom and weapon passed down through generations in Birgitta's family, known for their long history as famous information brokers. It symbolizes a crucial lesson that they should always remain observers, making level-headed decisions by viewing situations from a distance.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 1.2% → 2.4% and Critical Hit Resistance by 20%.
artifacts.lore_en: A tool used to measure the depth of rivers and seas. No one would dream of using it as a weapon because of its sheer weight, except Wukong, the only one who can wield it at will.

artifacts.effect_en:
Increases Critical Hit Chance and Effectiveness of all allies by 10%. Effect does not stack with other Artifacts of the same name.
The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: You little thief! You can't just eat the customer's pizza! Agh... People are going to think it was me!

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 1.5% → 3%. After attacking on the caster's turn, has a 3.5% → 7% chance to inflict a random debuff on the target for 1 turn. (Decrease Speed, Stun, Unhealable, or Venom)
artifacts.lore_en: Grandpa, you told me that brighter days are just around the corner. Looking at the smiles on the faces of those around me, I believe those days have finally arrived.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the first battle, acquires 10 Soul. After an ally uses a Soulburn, has a 5% → 10% chance to acquire 10 Soul. Can only be activated once.
artifacts.lore_en: A hair tie Choux gave to Frida as a gift to keep her long hair from getting wet. Although at first, Frida complained that only a kid would use something like this, she secretly loves it.

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking, increases damage dealt by 20% against Elite or Boss monsters. The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: Hey... I feel like every day we spend together is a gift. All my hardships seem to fade away when I'm with you. Th-This is a strawberry cake I made! I'm not sure if it'll taste good...but I made it just for you. I promise there's nothing weird inside...! Would you...please accept it?

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Damage by 1.5% → 3%. If the caster attacks when it's not their turn, has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Attack of the caster for 1 turn before attacking. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A hair accessory Landy gave to Flan as a gift. Feeling deeply touched, Flan wore it throughout the entire vacation.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Health of the caster and the foremost ally except for the caster by 5% → 10%. At the end of the turn, has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Combat Readiness of the foremost ally by 15%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: An emerald-jeweled accessory made by Alencia as a birthday gift for Young Senya. When Young Senya uses in times of danger, she can summon Alencia.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack of all allies by 5% → 10%. After using an attack that targets all enemies, has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Combat Readiness of all allies by 15%. Can only be activated once every 3 turns, and the Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: Among the items left by his mother were books that contain all her knowledge and strong will, as well as vivid traces of her several exciting adventures. These became the bedrock for his newly found resolve.

artifacts.effect_en: After an ally is attacked, when the damage suffered is equivalent to 25% or more of max Health, grants a barrier to the target for 2 turns. Barrier strength is equivalent to 1% → 2% of the caster's max Health. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A luxurious, customized pen that once belonged to the former king, Tarman. It was mounted on a specially designed display stand, but Schniel has been using it as his dedicated signing pen since taking the throne. "Tools are meant to be used for their purpose, not worshipped. Even a nation’s king must abide by this rule."

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the turn, recovers Health by 250 → 500. Increases the effect of all healing received by allies by 1% → 2%. When more than one increased healing effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied.
artifacts.lore_en: Word of advice: think twice before reaching for a convenience store item the girl has been staring at, or you might unleash her inner devil.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 8% → 16%. After a Single Attack, a critical hit inflicts injuries equal to damage dealt, up to 6% → 12% of the target's max Health.
artifacts.lore_en: These snake fangs crave Fenne, but she believes it's just Papa's way of showing love.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 10% → 20%. At the start of battle, grants a barrier equivalent to 50% → 100% of Attack for 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: Buried under mounting misunderstandings, Tori withdraws from the world. Alone in her darkened room, she silently hopes her true feelings will somehow reach others.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the first battle, acquires 10 Soul. When attacking, increases damage dealt by 5% → 10%, and when using Soulburn, increases damage dealt by an additional 1% → 2%.
artifacts.lore_en: A mystic blade once kept in the Hilag family’s secret vault, deemed too dangerous for anyone to wield. While it consumes immense mana from its wielder, it grants devastating strength in return. After using this sword, Krau always takes advantage of its side effects as an excuse to request paid leave.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 10%. After attacking, increases Attack and Critical Hit Damage by 2% → 4%. Can stack up to 6 times. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en:
“No, no! This is mine, keep your hands off!”
Out of breath, Witch Skinneri frantically poured magic into her broom, narrowly dodging the grasp of the Phantom Wind and escaping by a hair.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking with a Single Attack, has a 5% → 10% chance to inflict additional damage proportional to the caster's Defense on the target.
artifacts.lore_en: Though originally designed to nullify magical attack damage, this device gained an auto-targeting feature at the whim of a developer.\n"The best defense is a strong offense... Ah, Earth's proverbs really do inspire romantic ideals! Don't you agree?"

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 1% → 2%. At the end of the turn, when the caster has a debuff, increases Combat Readiness by 1.5% → 3% and grants stealth for 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: Swift as the wind, Rinak picks her clients' pockets to gather criminal funds. Little does she know that her actions are being observed...

artifacts.effect_en: After using an attack that targets all enemies, gain 10 Soul, and has a 5% → 10% chance to inflict burn for 1 turn. Soul can only be acquired once.
artifacts.lore_en: “Doesn’t matter who you are or where you’ve scurried off to, I will find you. You see — your life? It’s got quite the lucrative price tag.”

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 5% → 10%. At the start of the turn, has a 3% → 6% chance to grant increased Critical Hit Damage for 1 turn.
artifacts.lore_en: Hwayoung steels herself to break free from the shackles that once held her back. As if fate preordained it, she’s now back on the path of the Sura. The hot summer sun and the rolling waves of the ocean will guide her.

artifacts.effect_en:
Increases the Friendship acquired after completing a stage in Adventure, Side Story, Spirit Altar, Emergency Mission, Hunt, Rift, and Otherworld Breach by the Hero who has this Artifact equipped by 100%.
The skill effect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
artifacts.lore_en: A traditional Earth dish recreated by the Science Recreation Club at Yuna's request. It's surprisingly addictive. "I did my best with the ingredients available here... but do people on Earth really eat something like this?"

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 1% → 2%. When attacking, if the target is not an Elite or Boss monster, has a 5% → 10% chance to ignore damage sharing effects.
artifacts.lore_en: Today’s photographer is the curious cat! A picture-perfect moment sealed with the final touch of the cat’s toe bean print, as summer memories are captured in the frame, one by one.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the first battle, has a 5% → 10% chance to grant immunity for 1 turn. At the start of the turn, when the caster does not have a debuff, has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Attack for 1 turn.
artifacts.lore_en: Driven by her enduring desire to sever all evil from the world, Star Fencer Alya channels her remaining energy into one final strike.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack of all allies by 5% → 10%. At the end of the ally with the highest Attack’s turn, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 1% → 2% Can only be activated once every 2 turns, and this Artifact’s skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: The glistening seafoam rolling with the waves, and the sun-scorched sands... It’s always around this time of year that the girl is reminded of a certain traumatic experience.

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking with a Single Attack, increases damage dealt by 1% → 2%.
artifacts.lore_en: The jumbo berry special that he could hardly finish as a kid and had to split with his master.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the first battle, gains 10 → 20 Soul. At the start of the turn, has a 5% → 10% chance to gain 2 Soul.
artifacts.lore_en: A ring gifted by Himmel. In flower-language, the mirrored lotus represents eternal love.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 1% → 2%. After attacking, grants a barrier equivalent to 2.5% → 5% of Attack for 2 turns. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A birthday gift from Frieren. It is one of Fern's most precious belongings that she has decorating her hair at all times.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance by 15%. When an ally's Health is 50% or less after being attacked, recovers Health of the target by 1% → 2%. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A real-life version of the all-healing magic wand from the children's anime Healing Angel Lidica, casually referenced by Yuna. No one knows how it really works, but it is without a doubt able to cure ailments. "I'm certain that I can cure any illness with this magic wand! But, if I want to use it... I should make sure someone is sick first, right?"

artifacts.effect_en:
Increases Evasion by 20%.
After counterattacking, when the target is still alive, has a 2% → 4% chance to activate the basic skill once more.
Increases Health by 10%. At the start of the turn, gain 10 Soul. Can only be activated twice. The skill efect of this Artifact does not increase when enhanced.
After using a non-attack skill, increases Combat Readiness of the caster and the ally in the back row except for the caster by 1.2% → 2.4%. Can only be activated once every 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: Witnessing the silent budding of life, Saria carved deep into her heart once more why she must protect Dun Blyraia.

artifacts.effect_en: When attacking, if a non-critical hit is made, increases damage dealt by 1% → 2%, and deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack to the target.
artifacts.lore_en: A forbidden tome that can only be read by the inheritor of Sigurd Scythe, the royal heirloom. It contains the lifespans of all Humans born and raised in Tartarus.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 1% → 2%. After using a basic skill on the caster's turn, has a 2% → 4% chance to grant an extra turn. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en: To Sharun, who binds herself in guilt, the Wicked, taking the form of Zio, sows nightmares. Step by step, a hungry shadow slowly approaches its prey.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Evasion by 20%. After an ally uses a basic skill, has a 5% → 10% chance to increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 10%. This Artifact's effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en:
"First to the finish line—Sigret! Truly, this is the age of Sigret!"
With breathtaking speed and brilliant riding skill, Sigret rose to fame overnight. After defeating her formidable rivals in her very firt race, the flag she waved at the finish line became a legend among racing fans.

artifacts.effect_en: At the end of every 3 enemy turns, increase Combat Readiness of the caster by 1% → 2% and has a 5% → 10% chance to dispel one debuff. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: "No matter how hard you try, you cannot hide it. The truth always lingers in the scent."

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 1% → 2%. After attacking with a Single Attack except for the basic skill, inflicts decreased Hit Chance on the target for 2 turns, and increases Combat Readiness of the ally in the back row by 1.5% → 3%. Can only be activated once every 3 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: A fountain pen bestowed by Schniel, the lord who recognized Ruiza's worth. When it comes time to sign her name, this is the only pen she uses.

artifacts.effect_en:
Increases Effect Resistance by 1.5% → 3%.
At the start of battle, grants a barrier equivalent to 6% → 12% of Attack for 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: After each battle, the moment Aki rewraps the bandages to subdue the raging flames feels like a painful ritual—one that brings back the memories of someone long lost.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases max Health by 5% → 10%. Decreases damage received from damage sharing by 2.5% → 5%.
artifacts.lore_en: A small bird encountered by chance on the journey home. The sky is clear, and footsteps are light. With a friend to accompany her, she is no longer lonely.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance by 1.5% → 3%. At the end of an enemy's turn, when the caster does not have a debuff, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 1% → 2%. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en:
"Goddess, have mercy on us"
The day she turned her back on fate, and the night she prayed the most earnestly.

artifacts.lore_en: An ancient relic with mysteriously unleashed power. It is to be bestowed upon the final champion of the Orbis Fladiatorium. It gleams with the brilliance of past glory.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking, has a 5% → 10% chance to deal additional damage proportional to the caster's max Health on the target.
artifacts.lore_en: A throne containing the might of the Star Devourer. Though its former master relinquished that power and departed, the throne still silently awaits the arrival of the next monarch.

artifacts.effect_en: When the caster takes the first turn, has a 5% → 10% chance to grant increased Effectiveness to the caster for 3 turns. When an ally except for the caster takes the first turn, has a 5% → 10% chance to increase Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: The special lens created by Fumyr's magic reveals even the slightest irregularites on the surface of a pebble. A sly curiousity subtly lingers on her face as she seeks new knowledge.

artifacts.effect_en:
Increases Attack by 1% → 2%.
At the start of the first battle, has a 5% → 10% chance to gain 10 Soul and grant swift attack to the caster. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: A gunblade specially crafted for Tactical Archetype Coli who excels in urban combat. Combining a firearm with blades, it can be used effectively at both close and long range.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the first battle, acquires 10 Soul. At the end of the turn, has a 5% → 10% chance to acquire 5 Soul. Can only be activated three times.
artifacts.lore_en: Some nights become the hope that leads to daybreak. For Ludwig, who is heading towards the dawn after a long darkness, there is no longer any reason to hesitate.

artifacts.effect_en: Increase Evasion by 1% → 2%. At the start of an extra turn, increases Attack and Speed by 5% each, Can stack up to 3 times.
artifacts.lore_en: Through a blood-stained baptism, two butterflies drifting over scattered dreams are connected as one. "The two of us are one that can never be seperated, Luciella."

artifacts.effect_en: After using a non-attack skill, has a 5% → 10% chance each to grant swift attack and, for 2 turns, grant increased Speed to the ally with the highest Attack. Can only be activated once every 3 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: Deep in the sea, the tentacles of the Void Coral wrap around Aube's body. A sweet and sticky wave slowly consumes her body and mind.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of the first battle, has a 50% → 100% chance to gain 10 Soul. After an ally is attacked by a Single Attack, increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 8% → 16%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: To others, it's an incredible weapon capable of generating immense force under extreme weight. To Haru, it's just another high school girl's accessory. It was orignally designed to generate gravity at a designated point, but after falling into Haru's hands, it became a blunt weapon.

artifacts.lore_en: A pistol Renoa always carries when she's not using her Gift. Driven by a desperate determination to never fall behind, she honed her skills until she could take on monsters with a single gun. From that resolve, the Black Rose bloomed.

artifacts.effect_en: After using an attack that targets all enemies, deals 1,000 → 2,000 additional damage, and has a 5% → 10% chance to decrease the Combat Readiness of the target by 15%.

artifacts.lore_en: "At the end of thousands upon thousands of worldlines, I finally found you. With this brilliant light as our promise... Come, let us step into tomorrow together."

artifacts.lore_en: What wishes may be granted by this Death Goblet that holds the blood of so many victims?

artifacts.effect_en: Increase Attack and Speed by 1% → 2% when Health is 50% or less.
artifacts.lore_en:
"Only those with the power to control their inner energy can wield this sword."
- Master Swordsman Rhynos

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 1% → 2% when Health is 50% or more.
artifacts.lore_en: If you really want to be strong, risk your Iife and challenge me.

artifacts.lore_en:
"As long as this brand is with you, the Devil wilI continue to protect you."
- Cult Enforcer Ebarak

artifacts.effect_en: When an enemy is defeated, has a 5% → 10% chance to acquire 1 Soul.
artifacts.lore_en: If you allow yourself to be seduced by the faint light floating upon the lake, the demon in the water will reach out for you.

artifacts.effect_en: 50% chance to grant a barrier to the caster equivalent to 5% → 10% of max Health for 2 turns at the moment the caster is attacked. Can only be granted once every 2 turns.
artifacts.lore_en: This rose of eternal beauty grants great magical power to the possessor.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Critical Hit Chance by 6% → 12%.
artifacts.lore_en:
The swing of his axe was unstoppable; his enemies becoming an ever-growing pile of corpses.
Written by Reingar Media Club [Special Edition: Testimony of Ancient Weapons 6, 44p]

artifacts.lore_en: A powerful tonfa capable of smashing bones and splitting flesh. They say that when the wielders of this weapon die, their souls are bound to it.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases damage dealt by 1.5% → 3% of the enemy's max Health when attacking.
artifacts.lore_en: Did you enjoy the world I showed you? Was it satisfying? Now, pay the price with your life.

artifacts.effect_en: 4% → 8% chance to be granted an extra turn at the end of the next turn when attacked.
artifacts.lore_en: A mandolin used by Ludo, a pure-voiced minstrel. If you play it, you can see an illusion of butterflies made of light dancing.

artifacts.lore_en: Look carefully at the smoke that rises from the pipe—you'll see within whether you're destined for paradise or hell.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Defense by 1% → 2% when Health is 50% or more.
artifacts.lore_en: A dark egg containing demonic energy. Nobody knows what it may contain inside.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking, has a 2% → 4% chance to dispel one debuff.
artifacts.lore_en:
"They say that the ship held down with that anchor is able to endure all strong winds."
- Written by Louis [The Adventures of Louis Van Vrista, Pg. 51]

artifacts.lore_en: A totem deep within the forest. Make a wish before it, and if you hear the clear ringing of a bell, your wish will come true.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Hit Chance by 1% → 2%.
artifacts.lore_en:
"A key made in honor of the heroes who defeated the ancient monster, Nankuda, engraved with their oath to protect the world."
- Philosopher Izet

artifacts.lore_en: It is said that you can see into the future by lighting a candle, putting it on this candlestick, and looking into the flame.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases damage dealt by basic skill by 8% → 16%.
artifacts.lore_en: This magical sheath is said to keep any blade from losing its sharpness.

artifacts.effect_en: 1% → 2% chance to decrease skill cooldown of all allies by 1 turn at the start of battle.
artifacts.lore_en: By going through that door, you can turn back time. It may be for a brief moment, but it's enough to gain momentum in a fight.

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking with a Single Attack, decreases Combat Readiness of the target by 2.5% → 5%.
artifacts.lore_en: It is said that this spear contains the souls of the spirits who protect the forest, and grants strong protection to those who wield it.

artifacts.effect_en: 1% → 2% chance to increase the caster's Combat Readiness by 15% at the end of the enemy's turn.
artifacts.lore_en: A strange relic that was found in the mysterious maze of Farche Frontier. With mysterious light emitting from it, it has the power to distort space with impact.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effectiveness by 2.5% → 5% for 1 turn at the start of battle.
artifacts.lore_en:
"Careful, it's a monster. Who knows what could happen if we go in the direction the compass is pointing."
- Adventurer Laurelai

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 1% → 2%. When the caster defeats an enemy with an attack, casts stealth for 1 turn and increases Attack of the caster by 2% → 4% for 1 turn at the start of their next turn.
artifacts.lore_en: Famously known as the Phantom Wind, Rinak would sneak into the mansions of the rich with ghost-like stealth and vanish with their most expensive possessions.

artifacts.effect_en: Penetrates Defense by 1% → 2% when attacking an enemy not at max Health.
artifacts.lore_en: Whenever Elyha, the leader of the Black Fog Company, wielded a knife, it got darker with blood and more brutal every time.

artifacts.effect_en: 5% → 10% chance to dispel one debuff from an ally at the beginning of the turn.
artifacts.lore_en:
"A potion of love, or a potion of eternal youth. Only one of each exists in this world. Which do you choose?"
- A Senior Fellow of the Alchemy Society, Pei

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Dual Attack Chance by 7% → 14%. When it is not the caster's turn, increases Attack by 30%.
artifacts.lore_en: Gun mage Amber Rose was an expert in lightweight magic and sharpshooting. Her magic bullets never missed, even when aimed at her own lover.

artifacts.effect_en: For the duration of the caster's turn, increases Dual Attack Chance of all allies except for the caster by 7% → 14% and increases Attack of all allies except for the caster by 20%.
artifacts.lore_en: Now, put your most expensive possession in this basket - it doubles! Put In two? Quadruples! This isn't a scam, trust me!

artifacts.effect_en: After attacking, heals the ally with the lowest Health by 1.3% → 2.6% of the damage dealt.
artifacts.lore_en: As I took a bite of the fruit, a red liquid spilled out. Instead of the copper smell of blood, the sweet scent of fruit emanated from it.

artifacts.effect_en: Effect Resistance increases by 3% → 6% when the caster's Health is 50% or more. When Health is less than 50%, the effect is halved.
artifacts.lore_en:
"When the eclipse began, those small gloves started to spew fire and engulf my whole body. The spirit inside the gloves had woken up, an we were able to defeat the Archdemon."
- Heir Aki

artifacts.effect_en: Has a 4% → 8% chance to dispel one buff from the enemy after attacking.
artifacts.lore_en:
"No matter how much power or darkness one wields, they're just a part of the audience."
Iela started to play the violin and her melody touched the hearts of all that heard It. Even the genius mage who was only interested in fighting was moved.

artifacts.effect_en: At the start of someone's turn, increases Attack and Critical Hit Chance of the caster by 2% → 4%. Effect stacks, and is removed after the caster attacks.
artifacts.lore_en:
"Look at this saw... isn't it awesome?"
- Notorious Lunatic, Ralakia

artifacts.effect_en: Increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 5% → 10% after an ally except for the caster is attacked by a single attack.
artifacts.lore_en:
As she lifted her lance, a cry burst out from behind her. She believed she would soon be able to overthrow the Archdemon.
"If I cannot do it, Goddess, give me the power to fight on forever."

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 8% → 16% when the enemy is defeated. Effect does not stack with other Artifacts of the same name.
artifacts.lore_en: This is the Sashe Ithanes. It is a flame that will shake the world on its axis, that will destroy people, cities, kingdoms, even dreams. Take it, and in my name bring an end to everything.

artifacts.effect_en: 1.5% → 3% chance to attack again with a basic skill when the target survives a basic skill attack. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en:
"Once this long fight is over, will everything go back to the way it was?"
Noha, who is later praised as the Hero of the Dejurak Desert, mused with a deep sigh.

artifacts.effect_en: Recovers 8% Health and increases Combat Readiness by 1% → 2% upon receiving damage equivalent to 20% or more of max Health at the moment the caster is attacked.
artifacts.lore_en:
"Wherever this talisman is, I will be too. To bring safety from storms, freedom from illness, Iife where once there was only ruin."
- Shaman Cizette

artifacts.effect_en: 5% → 10% chance to be revived with 25% Health and granted a barrier for 1 turn after dying. Barrier strength is proportional to the caster's max Health. Can only be activated once.
artifacts.lore_en:
The Statue of Grace is given to whichever knight wins the Goddess's favor and will save them from death once before shattering to pieces.
Written by Barret [Treasures of the Sacred Kingdom, 15p]

artifacts.effect_en: Has a 1% → 2% chance to counterattack when an ally except for the caster is attacked.
artifacts.lore_en: A ceremonial sword handed down by the Elves for thousands of years, the blade is infused with several springs of magic. The person who owns this sword becomes the king of Elves.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 10%.1% → 2% chance to be granted an extra turn at the end of the turn. Can only be activated once per turn.
artifacts.lore_en:
"You're today's target."
"I'll let you know now that there's nowhere to run."
- Moon Assassins, Rhianna and Luciella

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Evasion by 1% → 2%. At the moment the caster is attacked, if the caster successfully evades, the caster is granted increased Attack for 1 turn.
artifacts.lore_en:
"Whether you take the path before you or not, it's al your choice to make."
The White Shining Blade's voice whispered in my mind.

artifacts.effect_en: 2.5% → 5% chance to inflict a random debuff for 1 turn after attacking (Decrease Attack, Decreases Hit Chance, Silence, Sleep, or Poison).
artifacts.lore_en: This rare magical flower blooms from the corpse of a Human who possessed incredible magic power. It quickly withers away unless it is constantly being infused with powerful Mana. Few have been lucky enough to witness such a sight.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack in the Hall of Trials by 2% → 4%. This Artifact's skill effect can only apply to one Hero within a team.
artifacts.lore_en: Once upon a time, a girl's parents asked a mage to transform their tomboyish daughter into an elegant lady. He fulfilled their request, and the parents were thrilled to see how obedient she had become, not realizing she had been replaced by a doll.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 1.5% → 3% after using a non-attack skill.
artifacts.lore_en: An ancient book written by a great mage. It contains all of Magaraha's magical research. Due to its complicate content and massive volume, even those ambitious enough to try to read it all had to give up after turning only a few pages.

artifacts.effect_en: Acquires 10 → 20 Souls at the start of the first battle.
artifacts.lore_en: A book written in the characters of the fallen Kingdom of Tagehel. Researchers are working hard to discover the meaning and principles behind the characters and unlock the mysterious power they hold.

artifacts.effect_en: 5% → 10% chance for an enemy to become targetted for 2 turns after a Single Attack.
artifacts.lore_en: As the strings start to vibrate, the starlight illuminates her.

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 10%. As Health decreases, Attack and Speed increase by up to 2.5% → 5%.
artifacts.lore_en:
"While holding this gauntlet, you can destroy anything you touch, as if it had never even existed!"
- Guard Maid, El

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Attack by 1% → 2%. When attacking, if the caster's Health is 50% or less, absorbs 2.5% → 5% of the damage dealt as Health.
artifacts.lore_en: As the moonlight revealed a figure holding a scythe, the astonished onlookers exclaimed "the God of Death has descended!"

artifacts.effect_en: Decreases Critical Hit Damage received by all allies by 8% → 16%. When more than one damage reduction effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied.
artifacts.lore_en:
"That damn shield can't be penetrated by anything. I guarantee you, cause even my sword couldn't."
- Star Fencer Ayla

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Effect Resistance of all allies by 20% and the effect of healing received by all allies by 2% → 4%. Effect does not stack with other artifacts of the same name. When more than one increased healing effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied.
artifacts.lore_en:
"Let's end this together."
- The Great Fallen Priest, Shimadra

artifacts.effect_en: 1.5% → 3% chance to stun the enemy for 1 turn after attacking.
artifacts.lore_en: "May those ruled by the crown walk the road of corruption forever." - Witch Reinwood, hung high up on the stake

artifacts.effect_en: Increases Defense of all allies by 10%. Receives 1% → 2% of damage suffered by all allies in their place. This effect does not stack with other Artifacts of the same name. When more than one damage distribution effect is granted, only the strongest effect is applied.
artifacts.lore_en: Legendary hero Knight Commander Rowell's tower shield.

artifacts.effect_en: 25% → 50% chance to decreases skill cooldown by 1 turn at the beginning of the turn.
artifacts.lore_en: When the empire is in its greatest peril, the exiled princess, Etica, will return with the five spirits to take back the royal hall and call own a rain of repentance to save the devastated world.
